**Migrated the last 12 holdouts** to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Files: `returnService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `couponService.js`, `refund.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `sla.js`, `cohort.js`, `session.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `shipment.js`.

Only `db.query` left is in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9), which is marked "vendored, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, do not edit" — left it alone.

Next: that vendor adapter will need its own fix once `query` is actually dropped from `lib/db.js`.
